verified_against: thermal_cultivation-1.20.1-11.0.1.24.jar (thermal:phytogro item + its phytogro_8 recipe live in thermal_core-1.20.1-11.0.6.24.jar embedded in thermal_foundation)

chain.title: Seeds from the Weeds
chain.desc: Break grass and ferns - fifteen kinds of Thermal crop seeds drop from them. Tomatoes are the one to plant first: they feed straight into the sauce every good dish wants.

chain.title: First Harvest
chain.desc: Plant the seeds on farmland and pick the tomatoes. Every Thermal crop drops extra seeds when mature, so one lucky grass drop becomes a whole field.

chain.title: Jars Before Jam
chain.desc: Two planks over four glass makes 8 Glass Jars. Sauces, jams and butters all come packed in jars, so this cheap craft gates the entire pantry.

chain.title: Sauce It
chain.desc: Six tomatoes into a jar. Tomato sauce is the shared ingredient behind Hearty Stew, Stuffed Pumpkin and Stuffed Pepper - make more than one.

chain.title: Rain on Demand
chain.desc: Four copper ingots around a bucket. Fill it at any water and sprinkle your fields - crops visibly grow faster, and it costs nothing but a moment of standing there.

chain.title: Strawberry Fields
chain.desc: Grow strawberries from grass-dropped seeds. Beyond snacking, six of them fill a jar with jelly - one half of the sandwich this mod is building toward.

chain.title: Jar of Jelly
chain.desc: Six strawberries into a jar. Sweet half of the PBJ, and Spice and Chocolate Cake bakers will want strawberries on hand too.

chain.title: Go Nuts
chain.desc: Peanut seeds also fall from grass. Grow a row - six peanuts to a jar of peanut butter, and the surplus compresses into blocks that fuel the Gourmand Dynamo.

chain.title: Jar of Peanut Butter
chain.desc: Six peanuts into a jar (or press five with a jar in the Multiservo Press). The savory half of the sandwich.

chain.title: The PBJ
chain.desc: Bread plus peanut butter plus jelly makes two sandwiches. Cheap, stackable, farm-renewable food that ends your rotten-flesh era for good.

chain.title: The Saddest Root
chain.desc: Grow Sadiroot from grass-dropped seeds. It looks like nothing, but it is the curdling agent for cheese and the spice in Spice Cake - no other crop substitutes.

chain.title: Wheel of Cheese
chain.desc: A milk bucket plus one sadiroot. Place it as a decorative wheel or cut it up - either way, this is renewable milk-to-food conversion.

chain.title: Cut the Cheese
chain.desc: One wheel cuts into four wedges. Wedges are eaten straight or folded into Stuffed Peppers - the fancy end of the kitchen.

chain.title: Hearty Stew
chain.desc: Carrot, potato, barley, onion, radish and a jar of tomato sauce in a bowl. One of the biggest food bars in the mod - the meal you take caving.

chain.title: Perspicacious Stew
chain.desc: Barley, eggplant, spinach and a Bottle o' Enchanting in a bowl. This stew feeds you experience - farmed XP without a mob grinder.

chain.title: Phyto-Gro
chain.desc: Sand, niter and two apatite craft 8 Phyto-Gro - bone meal's industrial cousin. It powers the Phytogenic Insolator and is an ingredient in the soil and spores ahead.

chain.title: Phyto-Soil
chain.desc: Ring dirt with Phyto-Gro and charcoal. Phyto-Soil accelerates anything planted in it around the clock - the endgame flowerbed for your most valuable crops.

chain.title: Glimmercap Spores
chain.desc: A red mushroom, glowstone dust, Phyto-Gro and a Bottle o' Enchanting. Plant the spores, harvest Glimmercaps, and smelt spores back into glowstone dust - renewable glowstone from a farm.

chain.title: Witch's Food Cake
chain.desc: Milk, sugar, amaranth, an egg and any potion baked together. Each slice eaten applies the potion - a placeable, seven-serving buff dispenser for your whole team.

collections.note: All fifteen wild seed types drop from breaking grass, tall grass and ferns (data/thermal/loot_modifiers/seeds_from_grass.json).
The rest of the harvest. Flax centrifuges into string, corn and eggplant cook into meals, and every crop has an Insolator recipe for automation.

Four resource mushrooms, each crafted from a mushroom, the matching resource, Phyto-Gro and a Bottle o' Enchanting; smelting spores returns the resource, making gunpowder, redstone and slime farmable.
The full cookbook - each dish pulls from several crop lines, so this is the natural completionist branch once the fields exist.

notes: All ids verified against the cultivation jar's recipes (data/thermal/recipes/), loot tables, tags and the seeds_from_grass loot modifier; display names confirmed in thermal_core's assets/thermal/lang/en_us.json (cultivation ships no lang file of its own - names live in the core jar embedded in thermal_foundation). Exact recipe contents (tomato_sauce = 6 tomato + jar, cheese_wheel = milk + sadiroot, xp_stew, potion_cake, phytosoil, glimmercap spores, watering_can, jar_4) all read from recipe JSONs. phytogro's recipe lives in thermal_core but is anchored here because the whole cultivation late game consumes it. Excluded from the chain: frost melon (frost_melon_seeds craft only from a slice and no worldgen/loot source for the first slice exists in data - source is code/trade-side, so it cannot honestly be a step), and coffee/tea/hops (seeds have no grass-loot or worldgen source in data and no Insolator recipes - trade-gated, unverifiable from the jar). The Phytogenic Insolator, Centrifugal Separator and Gourmand Dynamo referenced in descs are thermal_expansion machines this module feeds recipes into.
